item.title: AI Integration with System Info Dashboard
item.description:
Turning a Work Log into a Feature

This program turns a simple system log into a real feature: live AI summaries inside my system info dashboard. I wanted analysis that feels immediate and reliable, not something that blocks the UI or fails silently when the model takes too long.

item.title: Steganography Image Encoder and Decoder
item.description:
Steganography image encoder and decoder

This is a simple program in python which is used to encode the text in the the image and also used to decode the text from an image with the help of opencv and numpy library by usiing the Least Common Bit meathod (LSB).

item.title: GUI Command and Control
item.description:
GUI Command and Control (Client + Controller)

I wanted a simple way to send system commands from a GUI and get the output back in real time. The result is a small Python command-and-control demo built on sockets with a tkinter controller. It is intentionally minimal: one GUI, a client that listens for commands, and a few safe system info queries.

item.title: Realtek Driver Updater
item.description:
Realtek Driver Updates Without the Busywork

I got tired of manually pulling from git, running make, and then installing with sudo make install every time I needed to rebuild the rtw88 driver. I wanted something cleaner — a one-stop GUI to handle the whole process with a few button clicks.

item.title: Hash-Cracker
item.description:
Hash-Cracker

I built a small, simple program that can crack SHA-256 hashes using a wordlist. It supports two workflows: pass a CSV of hashes or enter a single hash interactively. I’ll keep making commits if I change anything.
